reason: A Windows desktop pet that monitors DeepSeek Harness sessions, displays status and message notifications, and supports two-way messaging plus DSH plugin-based lifecycle management.

summaries.zh: 这是一个运行在 Windows 上的桌面宠物插件，可监控 DeepSeek Harness 会话并通过气泡和托盘通知提示任务状态，同时支持发送消息。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop pet plugin that monitors DeepSeek Harness sessions, shows task and message notifications, and supports sending messages to the active session.

capabilities: Monitors local DSH sessions through HTTP and WebSocket interfaces
Displays desktop, tray, sound, and bubble notifications
Sends user messages to the current DSH session
Launches and stops a Windows desktop process
Creates or repairs plugin links and profile registrations
